text:
pagerduty-bot: Paging: prod inference service high error rate (503/500) and latency spike for /chat/generate — triggered at 03:12 UTC. Severity: P1. Link: https://incident.redwood/dashboard/INC-4621
alex: I'm on it — pulling logs and recent deploys.
maya: saw alerts for KV cache eviction storms earlier, could be related.
sam: rolling buffer of upstream retry throttles in the runtime, that might amplify 503s. starting live tail: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --since=10m`
jess: customers reporting timeouts in support channel, tagging @product-eng for comms.
alex: quick check — no deploys in last 2 hours, but config update to cache eviction policy at 01:40 (auto-rollout).
infra-sre: oncall-runbook step1: confirm if routing to dedicated pool is overloaded or if requests are failing inside runtime.
ops-bot: Hint: route metrics show 3x increase in p50/p95 for chat, and 4000 5xx in 10m.
maya: reproducing locally shows prefix cache misses spike when eviction threshold lowered — runtime re-populates KV causing many cold KVs and concurrent model loads.
sam: mitigation idea: temporarily raise eviction threshold back to previous value and enable fallback routing to smaller model variant for non-critical requests.
jess: agree. I'll post a customer advisory draft after we have mitigation.
alex: applying config rollback for cache.eviction_threshold = 0.15 -> 0.30 (previous). `rdctl config apply --name cache-evict --set eviction_threshold=0.30`
ops-bot: Config change submitted, rollout started (strategy: immediate to inference clusters in prod).
alex: also opening a temporary routing rule: send requests with x-priority=low to model variant 'redwood-small-v1' to reduce backend load. `rdctl routing add --route low-priority --model redwood-small-v1 --percent 100`
maya: warming up model variant and prepopulating KV for hot prefixes with a targeted warm-up job: `python tools/warm_kv.py --prefixes /top10 --model small-v1`
infra-sre: after the rollback + routing change, 5xxs dropping and latency improving. p95 back to baseline in ~4m.
alex: confirmed. paging status: mitigated, switching to monitoring and next steps discussion. tagging @product-eng for customer impact assessment.
product-eng: customers A, B, C hit higher errors for ~12 minutes window, SLA exposure — need postmortem and customer notes.
jess: scheduling postmortem: propose 2pm UTC today in #postmortems or 1:1 with impacted teams? We should include runtime, infra, product, and docs.
sam: prefer a synchronous 45m postmortem + a written doc in the incident tracker. I'll draft initial timeline.
maya: immediate action items: 1) revert eviction policy (done) 2) add canary gate for eviction change 3) KV warm-up job automation 4) routing health-check to trigger fallback earlier.
alex: assigning owners: 2) sam, 3) maya, 4) infra-sre. I'll own the written timeline.
ops-bot: Reminder: create follow-up tickets with tags incident:INC-4621 and priority:high.
jess: created INC-4621-postmortem (https://incidents.redwood/INC-4621). I've added initial notes and impacted customers.
infra-sre: proposed remediation: add a safety check in config rollout that blocks eviction_threshold decreases below 0.25 unless a canary passes for 30m. Will write a PR.
sam: also think we need better dashboard signals: KV eviction rate, model load concurrency, and a synthetic probe that exercises KV-hot prefixes. Adding to my backlog.
maya: for training share-out: let's do a 30m brown-bag next Wed 10am UTC covering "KV cache eviction and safe deploy patterns" — will include demo of warm-up job.
jess: makes sense — I'll schedule and invite infra, runtime, SRE, and product support.
alex: TL;DR for execs: transient config change to cache eviction led to cache churn -> cold KV loads -> concurrency spikes -> increased failures and latency. Mitigated by rollback, routing fallback, and KV warm-up. Postmortem and action items created.
product-eng: thanks team. please add customer-facing summary draft to the postmortem before EOD.
alex: will do. I'll attach logs, timeline, config diff, and command snippets used for mitigation.
infra-sre: tracking remediation tasks in qa: https://tasks.redwood/board/INC-4621-remediations.
maya: adding a simple playbook entry under runbooks: `If eviction policy change causes 5xx spike -> rollback -> route low-priority -> warm-up -> monitor 10m`
sam: noting retrospective item: consider automated KV warm-up when models are scaled or eviction is adjusted.
jess: brown-bag scheduled and calendar invites sent. topic line: "Preventing cache-churn incidents: patterns and playbook".
alex: thanks everyone. switching the thread to postmortem drafting mode — ping here for any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
